title: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back

entities.name: Niko Aris
entities.description: A former planeswalker from Theros who follows Winter with the Wanderer and finds only void where their spark was.

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: The sparkless Emperor of Kamigawa who is searching for Nashi and threatens Winter with her sword.

entities.name: Winter
entities.description: A scrawny survivor who dresses in wallpaper strips, knows the House's tricks and agrees to guide Niko and the Wanderer.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A planeswalker who falls through the floor, endures a vision of a dragon-burned forest and city, and meets Jace in a basement.

entities.name: Himoto
entities.description: Kaito's small spirit companion who clings to his shoulder throughout his fall.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker mind mage who meets Kaito in a basement and is punched by him; he and Kaito were enemies on New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Zimone Wola
entities.description: A Strixhaven researcher who studies the House's library and learns the house was built long ago by an architect.

entities.name: Tyvar Kell
entities.description: An elf prince who protects Zimone from a distorting creature in the library, using stone-skin power that no longer requires physical material.

entities.name: Nashi
entities.description: The lost child the Wanderer and Niko came to find.

entities.name: Kyodai
entities.description: A spirit dragon the Wanderer loves, whom she briefly mistakes the golden glimmer for.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A person Kaito says was lost because of Jace.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A time mage whose magic Kaito recalls when the vision feels wrong.

entities.name: Professor Vess
entities.description: A professor at Zimone's college who recommends rethinking academic goals after studying dark magic.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The dragon whose monitoring box transmits to Ravnica.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: The aware, hungry house-plane that uses lures and splits groups to cultivate fear.

entities.name: The Floodpits
entities.description: A dangerous area of the House.

entities.name: Razorkin
entities.description: Slaughterhouse monsters that the House makes from survivors and sends after the frightened.

entities.name: Glimmer
entities.description: A spirit of hopes and dreams that everyone in Duskmourn has; the Wanderer's is a golden dragon of light.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: Where Kaito and Jace last fought each other.

entities.name: The sylex
entities.description: A device Jace tried to activate and Kaito stopped to save Kamigawa.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes, whose flicker Niko can no longer feel.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The Wanderer's home plane, which Kaito saved from the sylex.

events.summary: Winter stops Niko and the Wanderer from stepping on the moths woven into the carpet.
events.quote: Don't step on any of the moths!

events.summary: Winter explains that the door they came through was a lure and that Duskmourn now holds them.
events.quote: But when you tried to turn around and go, the door wasn't there anymore.

events.summary: Niko instinctively reaches for their spark and finds only void.
events.quote: they found nothing where that tiny flicker of the Blind Eternities should have been, only void

events.summary: The Wanderer tells Winter they came to find a lost child, Nashi.
events.quote: We came seeking a child who has been lost

events.summary: The Wanderer draws her sword on Winter and warns him not to taunt them.
events.quote: Her sword, which had been belted at her hip, was suddenly in her hands, the blade only inches from Winter's face.

events.summary: Winter explains that the House splits groups to isolate and frighten them.
events.quote: That's Duskmourn, splitting you from your friends

events.summary: Winter reveals that razorkin are rebuilt survivors the House beguiles into slaughterhouse skins.
events.quote: Duskmourn repairs and rebuilds the people it takes, the same way an upholsterer might re-cover a couch.

events.summary: Winter points out the Wanderer's glimmer, a golden dragon of light; she reacts as if to Kyodai but recognizes it is not.
events.quote: There, floating several feet above the parlor floor, hovered a golden dragon etched entirely of light

events.summary: Winter explains that everyone in Duskmourn has a glimmer; Niko asks where theirs is.
events.quote: Everyone in Duskmourn has one.

events.summary: The glimmer leads the group through a doorway on a safe path.
events.quote: the glimmer began to swim through the air to a doorway on the far wall.

events.summary: Kaito falls through the floor with Himoto clinging to him.
events.quote: Himoto's claws dug into his shoulder as she anchored herself, refusing to be separated from him

events.summary: Kaito lands on a forest floor beneath the ballroom, unhurt despite the fall.
events.quote: his descent ended in a hard impact with what felt like a forest floor.

events.summary: A dragon appears overhead and burns the dying forest.
events.quote: The shadow swooped by again, this time accompanied by a brilliant burst of flame

events.summary: The dragon's fire engulfs Kaito, and he finds himself on a burned plain beside a burning city, in what feels like a staged performance.
events.quote: it was a performance being put on for Kaito's benefit—or for the House's.

events.summary: Dozens of dragons circle a burning city in the vision.
events.quote: Dragons wheeled through the sky overhead, dozens of them, their attention fixed on a burning city.

events.summary: The vision tears like paper and Kaito stands in a basement with a dying candle light.
events.quote: he appeared to be standing in an underground room with rough stone walls and a staircase in one corner

events.summary: Kaito senses someone approaching and punches Jace in the face.
events.quote: he whirled, driving his right fist square into the face of the slender, dark-haired man who'd been walking up behind him.

events.summary: Kaito and Jace quarrel over their fight on New Phyrexia and the sylex.
events.quote: Last time I saw you, we were trying to kill each other on New Phyrexia!

events.summary: A groaning sound fills the basement and Kaito and Jace stand back to back, agreeing to fight later.
events.quote: Jace and Kaito both stiffened, instinctively falling into position back to back

events.summary: Zimone and Tyvar remain in the library as Zimone researches.
events.quote: The library had remained a library, to Zimone's delight and Tyvar's disappointment.

events.summary: Zimone discovers the house was built by an architect who lived there with her family and has had many owners.
events.quote: the original architect lived here with her family, a long, long time ago

events.summary: Zimone reports the library focuses on occultism and entropy-based magic that may explain the House.
events.quote: mostly it's occultism and the kind of magic that makes Professor Vess recommend you rethink your academic goals.

events.summary: A ripping sound sounds nearby and the bookshelves begin to warp as a creature emerges.
events.quote: warping into strange, asymmetrical shapes

events.summary: A six-eyed, clay-skinned creature leaps from the twisting hole and attacks Tyvar.
events.quote: It slammed into Tyvar's chest, claws digging deep into bare shoulders as it twisted to rip his throat out.

events.summary: Tyvar throws a marble bust at the creature's head to draw it from Zimone.
events.quote: He grabbed the closest of them, feeling the structure of the stone bleeding into his skin, and flung the bust as hard as he could at the creature's head.

events.summary: Tyvar says he has been working on his legend since his spark blew out.
events.quote: I've been working on my legend since mine blew out.

events.summary: Tyvar stomps through the creature's sternum, killing it.
events.quote: driving his foot through the creature's sternum

events.summary: The creature pulls itself back together and rises again.
events.quote: The creature was pulling itself back together

events.summary: Tyvar and Zimone flee into the shadows of the library.
events.quote: together they turned and fled deeper into the library

relations.note: Offers to guide them and keep them alive.
relations.quote: Stick with me if you want to stay alive

relations.note: Calls Kyodai her dear one and would not wish her in the House.
relations.quote: This spirit is too small to be my dear one.

relations.note: Companion who is always with him.
relations.quote: Himoto was with him, as she always was, as she always would be.

relations.note: They fought on New Phyrexia and remain bitter about it.
relations.quote: Last time I saw you, we were trying to kill each other on New Phyrexia!
She's not for you to harm
